from pathlib import Path
program = '''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Find the solid, single-color divider between two equal-sized panels.
    for r in range(h):
        if grid[r] and grid[r][0] != 0 and all(v == grid[r][0] for v in grid[r]):
            if r > 0 and h-r-1 == r:
                a, b = grid[:r], grid[r+1:]
                return [[2 if x != 0 and y != 0 else 0 for x, y in zip(ra, rb)] for ra, rb in zip(a, b)]
    for c in range(w):
        if grid[0][c] != 0 and all(row[c] == grid[0][c] for row in grid):
            if c > 0 and w-c-1 == c:
                a = [row[:c] for row in grid]
                b = [row[c+1:] for row in grid]
                return [[2 if x != 0 and y != 0 else 0 for x, y in zip(ra, rb)] for ra, rb in zip(a, b)]
    raise ValueError('No equal-panel divider found')
'''
